text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: metering-usage-pipeline-lag (P1) — high consumer lag on billing-ingest (>= 45m). Potential invoice risk. Pager: pagerduty, escalation level 1.

pagerduty: Incident created, incident #PD-4821, runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/metering-ingest-lag.

sam oncall: ack — I'm on it. Jumping into consumer metrics now.

lina sre: I'm here too. Which cluster?

sam oncall: eu-west-1 primary cluster. Dashboard shows consumer lag spike starting ~1739452300.

maria billing: Customer invoices generate nightly at 02:00 UTC; if this isn't cleared we risk undercounting and invoice blockers for a subset of customers. Need ETA for backlog drain.

raj platform: I'm checking the autoscaler and pod restarts. Running: `kubectl -n metering get sts billing-ingest -o wide`

raj platform: output:
```
NAME            READY   AGE
billing-ingest  3/5     8d
```

raj platform: looks like two pods failed to come up; autoscaler didn't replace quickly. Possible image pull backoff noted earlier in events.

sam oncall: checking kafka consumer group lag: `kafka-consumer-lag --group billing-ingest --topic usage-events`

sam oncall: output snippet:
```
partition 0 lag  1,234,567
partition 1 lag  98,432
partition 2 lag  345,210
total lag ~1.68M
```

lina sre: huge. That will take hours to drain on current throughput. We should scale replicas and, if needed, run a fast-path consumer to prioritize invoice-critical topics.

sam oncall: scaling billing-ingest statefulset to 8 replicas now. Command: `kubectl scale sts billing-ingest --replicas=8 -n metering`

ops-ic: before scaling, we should check KV cache memory pressure — more replicas could increase memory contention on brokers. Any OOMs?

raj platform: checking broker metrics... no OOMs visible, CPU spike only. Brokers have spare capacity. Proceed with scaling.

lina sre: also enabling temporary increased parallelism in consumer config: set `max.poll.records=5000` and `fetch.max.wait.ms=50` for the fast-path. Patching config now.

sam oncall: patch applied. Rolling update started for billing-ingest. Watching pods come up.

incident-bot: Deploy started by sam oncall; change id deploy-7831.

sam oncall: new pods healthy: 8/8 ready. Throughput increased ~3.8x.

sam oncall: re-running lag check...
```
kafka lag total ~640k
```

maria billing: progress — is list of affected customers stable? Can we produce a preliminary impact list?

lina sre: pulling latest offsets vs ledger checkpoint. Running diff job now (small script).

lina sre: script output (truncated):
```
customers with missing tokens: 112
sum missing tokens ~ 2.1M
top affected: cust-1012 (350k), cust-2231 (180k), cust-998 (150k)
```

maria billing: thanks. Flagging cust-1012 for potential manual invoice hold; ops for manual review.

ops-ic: Can we speed draining by temporarily increasing consumer parallelism on those partitions? We can run a dedicated consumer pod pinned to partitions with the largest lag.

sam oncall: spinning up dedicated partition-reader pod pinned to partition 0 and 2. Using command: `kubectl run part-reader --image=redwood/partition-reader:canary -n metering --env TOPIC=usage-events --partition-list=0,2`

sam oncall: dedicated reader started and consuming at ~120k msg/s for those partitions. Lag on partition 0 drops quickly.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by sam oncall. Escalation paused.

raj platform: note — image canary has higher memory but short-lived; monitor node memory.

lina sre: node mem steady. Dedicated reader is doing work. Total lag now ~210k.

maria billing: timeline estimate? If current drain rate holds, we can clear backlog in ~25 minutes. That will be before overnight invoice run.

sam oncall: agreed — continue to monitor. Notifying legal/PMs: @maria billing please craft a short customer-facing blurb in case we need to notify anyone.

maria billing: drafting notification template and will hold until we confirm final counts.

ops-ic: adding mitigation steps to runbook: temp-scale + partition-reader pattern. Will PR after incident.

sam oncall: lag is now < 10k, rebalancing in progress. Dedicated reader terminating.

sam oncall: final lag check:
```
kafka lag total ~0
```

lina sre: verifying ledger ingestion reconciles -> running ledger-check job.

lina sre: ledger-check result: reconciled tokens match expected for all flagged customers. cust-1012 discrepancy resolved (was delayed ingest).

maria billing: great. No invoice holds needed. I'll update stakeholders and close the loop with PM/ops.

sam oncall: incident mitigated. Leaving channel open for postmortem notes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident #PD-4821 resolved by sam oncall (1739460427).

raj platform: handing off to next-day oncall (lina sre) for follow-up on autoscaler/STS resume time.

lina sre: taking follow-up. Action items: 1) root cause: investigate why two replicas failed to come up (image pullbackoff?) 2) add circuit to autoscaler to reattempt quicker 3) PR runbook updates (partition-reader pattern + config knobs) 4) add alert to surface image-pullbackoff as early warn.

ops-ic: filing postmortem ticket: INT-2026, assigned to raj platform and lina sre. Due EOD tomorrow.

maria billing: I'll loop in finance for any retrospective invoice checks and confirm no billing anomalies.

sam oncall: thanks team. Good coordination. :thumbsup:

(reacts: many :white_check_mark: and :tada: in the thread)
